scope: Temporal, provenance-aware Fortnite lore resolution, safe traversal, search views and calendar materialization

principles.entity_plus_claim_model: V1 registry supplies stable entities/legacy relations; V2 graph supplies scoped claims, corrections and new entities.
principles.as_of_first: Resolve temporal validity before traversing a relation. A true claim in one season is not silently true in another.
principles.query_not_fact: Reverse traversal and neighborhood expansion are search operations only unless a forward claim independently satisfies materialization rules.
principles.claim_status_matters: SUPERSEDED/RETRACTED claims remain auditable but are excluded from current-fact results unless history is explicitly requested.
principles.provenance_visible: Every strong V2 answer can expose source_id, source_url, evidence level, scope and claim_id.
principles.no_fandom_completion: Unknown membership, role, causation, timeline or identity remains unknown.

filter_modes.STRICT: Direct event assignments plus ACTIVE OFFICIAL_EXPLICIT claims matching the requested scope.
filter_modes.EXPANDED: STRICT + ACTIVE OFFICIAL_CROSS_REFERENCE and safe forward derivations, maximum depth 2.
filter_modes.CANON_ONLY: MAIN_STORY only by default; COLLAB_CANON requires explicit opt-in/context; excludes GAMEPLAY_ONLY/COSMETIC_ONLY/META/UNKNOWN.
filter_modes.CHAPTER_VIEW: Query-only neighborhood for a chapter, including events, POIs, organizations, objects and characters reachable through scoped claims.
filter_modes.ENTITY_VIEW: Query-only neighborhood for one entity, optionally constrained by chapter/season/as_of.
filter_modes.TIMELINE_VIEW: Historical sequence and scoped participation; chronology never becomes causation.
filter_modes.WHO_VIEW: Characters/organizations participating in or linked to an event/POI/object within scope.
filter_modes.WHERE_VIEW: POI/island/reality context for an entity/event within scope.
filter_modes.WHEN_VIEW: Chapter/season/event/date scopes in which a claim is valid.
filter_modes.RELATIONSHIP_VIEW: Show explicit/scoped relationships between two entities with provenance and status.
filter_modes.HISTORY_VIEW: Include superseded/retracted claims and correction chains without treating them as current facts.

claim_resolution.disputed_policy: DISPUTED is returned only when explicitly requested or when needed to explain an unresolved conflict; never materialize to ICS.
claim_resolution.supersession: If an ACTIVE claim supersedes another claim_id, current views use the newer claim while HISTORY_VIEW retains both.
claim_resolution.parallel_scope: Claims with different temporal/canon scopes may coexist even if their predicates differ.

scope_matching.date_filter: If valid_from/valid_to exist, as_of must fall inside the interval; open boundaries are allowed.
scope_matching.unknown_scope_guard: An unscoped relation may answer generic ENTITY_VIEW but must not be used to assert a season-specific fact unless another matching claim exists.

materialization.rule: QUERY_EXPANDED, PROVISIONAL, DISPUTED, SUPERSEDED and RETRACTED never become strong ICS facts.

AFFILIATED_WITH.note: Weaker than permanent membership; preferred when official wording does not establish formal membership.

role_policy.no_reverse_inference: Role never proves membership, canon participation, alliance or permanent character identity.

participation_policy.co_presence_guard: Two entities linked to the same event are not automatically allies, enemies or causally related.
participation_policy.event_to_entity: Participation claims are primarily query context; materialize only when the actual calendar event explicitly names that participant.

canon_policy.COLLAB_CANON: Separate canon scope; included only when the query/context opts in.
canon_policy.GAMEPLAY_ONLY: Excluded from CANON_ONLY and strong story inference.
canon_policy.COSMETIC_ONLY: Excluded from CANON_ONLY and strong story inference.

calendar_assignment_policy.when_to_tag: Lore/story event, season/update with explicit story content, or official event description materially naming the entity in matching scope.
calendar_assignment_policy.when_not_to_tag: Competitive, ticketing, generic service, routine pass/ranked deadline and unrelated product events remain lore-free.
